features.title: Convert Collection and Tag to proper SwiftData @Model relationships
features.user_visible_behavior: Assigning a SavedItem to a Collection or Tag persists as a real relationship (not a raw string/array), so renaming a Collection updates everywhere it's used and deleting a Tag doesn't orphan data silently.
verification: Manual: create item, assign to Collection, rename Collection in UI, confirm item still shows correct name after relaunch
features.notes: Blocks data-model-reminder-viewed and thumbnail-rendering if they touch SavedItem's relationships. Do this first.

features.title: Add reminderDate and viewedAt fields to SavedItem
features.user_visible_behavior: User can set a reminder date on a saved item from the detail view; item is marked viewed (viewedAt set) the first time its detail view is opened.
verification: Manual: set reminderDate on an item, relaunch app, confirm value persisted; open detail view, confirm viewedAt is set and unread badge clears
features.notes: Confirm lightweight-migration-safety for existing SwiftData store before shipping; both fields should be optional to avoid migration issues.

features.title: Render OG-parsed thumbnail image on grid cards and detail view
features.user_visible_behavior: Saved items with a parsed Open Graph image show that image on the grid card and detail view; items without one show the existing placeholder treatment (no fallback thumbnail generation).
verification: Manual: save a URL with an OG image, confirm it renders in both zoom levels that show images; save a URL without an OG image, confirm no fallback thumbnail is generated
features.notes: OG parsing only, per AGENTS.md — no oEmbed, no fallback thumbnail mechanism.

features.title: Add macOS 3-column masonry branch to grid layout
features.user_visible_behavior: On macOS (MenuBarExtra popover), the mid-zoom masonry grid renders 3 columns instead of the iOS 2-column layout.
verification: Manual: open MenuBarExtra popover on macOS, pinch/zoom to masonry level, confirm 3 columns render and reflow correctly on window resize
features.notes: Grid is currently hardcoded 2-column with no macOS branch — this is additive, should not touch iOS layout code path.
